g.text: If the algorithm family is rsa-oaep, P11 calls Encrypt() and Decrypt()
from the JWE asymmetric key-based encryptors for RSA ciphers. Since
gose v1.0.0-rc2, key wrapping/unwrapping via crypto11 lives in the
upstream gose/hsm package rather than in a local P11 wrapper.
define which algorithm family (aes-cbc, aes-gcm, rsa-oaep, ml-kem) will be called
For KEK rotation, P11 carries a parallel set of old* fields
(d *JweRsaKeyEncryptionDecryptorImpl) Decrypt(jwe string, hash crypto.Hash) (plaintext, aad []byte, err error)
(plaintext, aad []byte, err error) Decrypt(jwe string, hash crypto.Hash)
p11.go always passes crypto.SHA256 explicitly, rather than
crypto.Hash(0) (which would derive the digest from the JWE
"alg" header), so objects written before gose v1.0.0-rc2
(header says RSA-OAEP/SHA-1, CEK is SHA-256-wrapped) still decrypt.
AsymmetricDecryptionKey. The method `Decrypt` is called for this key.
`Encrypt` calls the standard Go crypto module for rsa encryption
using a given RSA public key.
EncryptOAEP(hash hash.Hash, random io.Reader, pub *PublicKey, msg []byte, label []byte) ([]byte, error)
NewAsymmetricDecryptionKey(ctx *crypto11.Context, keyPair crypto11.SignerDecrypter, kid []byte, opts crypto.DecrypterOpts) (*AsymmetricDecryptionKey, error)
Decrypt(rand io.Reader, msg []byte, opts DecrypterOpts) (plaintext []byte, err error)
Sign(rand io.Reader, digest []byte, opts SignerOpts) (signature []byte, err error)
(priv *pkcs11PrivateKeyRSA) Decrypt(rand io.Reader, ciphertext []byte, options crypto.DecrypterOpts) (plaintext []byte, err error)
(priv *pkcs11PrivateKeyRSA) Sign(rand io.Reader, digest []byte, opts crypto.SignerOpts) (signature []byte, err error)
